description: This file defines the API endpoint class 'AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI' for checking punch-out overlaps in an attendance tracking system. It extends another API class and provides a method 'getOne' to handle GET requests, validate parameters, invoke attendance service methods, and return results about punch-out record overlaps.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API class for checking punch-out record overlaps, extending the attendance punch-in overlap API.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to check for punch-out overlaps, retrieves parameters, calls attendance service, and returns overlap status.
